GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2024-09-03T19:37:10Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: s3 table function fetch the whole parquet instead of metadata for count when it's a small file
Description: ### Company or project name

_No response_

### Question

i observed an issue with select count(*) from s3() reading parquet files that are small (900-1000KB)
when i check how much byte it read
it shows ReadBufferFromS3Bytes = sum of size of all files
but if i merge 2 files together and size is about 1.8MB
```
INSERT INTO FUNCTION s3(gcs_login, filename = 'clickhouse/test_merged.parquet') SELECT *
FROM s3(gcs_login, filename = 'clickhouse/account_id=..../dataset_name=..../group_id=..../device_id=..../time_cadence=..../time=..../{0,1}.parquet', format = 'Parquet')
```
and try again, it only fech 64KB which i think it's the metadata


```
SELECT
    query,
    formatReadableSize(ProfileEvents['ReadBufferFromS3Bytes']) AS bytes
FROM system.query_log
WHERE (event_date = today()) AND (query_id IN ('85c68382-d77f-4f23-929b-27752199a873', '209b6fd3-7dd8-432b-9c91-d7adbb9efd6d')) AND (type = 'QueryFinish')
ORDER BY event_time DESC;

Query id: 6f912e2d-ded3-4a29-ba2f-004bff20ff47

   ┌─query──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┬─bytes─────┐
1. │ select count(*) from s3(gcs_login,filename='clickhouse/test_merged.parquet', format='Parquet');                                                                                        │ 64.00 KiB │
2. │ select count(*) from s3(gcs_login,filename='clickhouse/account_id=..../dataset_name=..../group_id=..../device_id=..../time_cadence=..../time=..../*', format='Parquet'); │ 66.17 MiB │
   └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┴───────────┘

2 rows in set. Elapsed: 0.005 sec.
```

is there any threshold that decide to fetch the whole file or just the metadata? can i force clickhouse to only read the metadata? we need to run qa validation script on few TB data to monitor the count and most of them are small files (<1.5MB) so it only make sense if we can just fetch the metadata.

Thanks
